standards_crosswalk.purpose: HIL, commissioning and periodic testing of microgrid monitoring/control/energy-management systems
Microgrid-controller test procedures and comparison metrics
Plant-level IBR conformity assessment for applicable bulk-system interconnections
Grid-forming IBR/CBR capability and performance recommended practice

stimulus: Matched multi-source demand trajectory with critical/noncritical intervals
Forecast update, source derating and terminal reserve obligation
required_observables: Decision latency, solver timeout and infeasibility
tests.positive_control: Feasible dispatch delivers critical service and terminal reserve with complete energy reconciliation.
tests.negative_control: Force an infeasible source/storage envelope, stale capability or weakened terminal reserve; the test must fail closed without false pass.
tests.recovery_control: Restore a valid source or reduce noncritical load; record re-plan and reserve restoration.
tests.claim_ceiling: Controller schedule and setpoints only; plant behavior claim is limited by the declared simulator/physical plant boundary.

stimulus: Timestamped load and renewable forecast across short and longer horizons
Injected bias, delay, missing update and regime shift
tests.positive_control: Correctly timestamped forecast with representative load/renewable trajectory.
tests.negative_control: Inject biased, stale, missing and out-of-distribution forecast; no future information leakage and bounded fallback.
tests.recovery_control: Publish a corrected forecast; record resynchronization and dispatch recovery without rewriting prior forecasts.
tests.claim_ceiling: Forecast quality and its dispatch impact under tested data/model boundary only.

stimulus: Demand response request with baseline and customer/service limits
Availability, opt-out, communication delay and rebound
required_observables: Metered load response at declared POC
tests.positive_control: Eligible demand response accepted and measured against preregistered baseline.
tests.negative_control: Reject non-consenting/unavailable resource; baseline manipulation or unmetered unrelated shed cannot earn response credit.
tests.recovery_control: End event and verify load rebound and restoration of customer obligation.
tests.claim_ceiling: Demand-side response is limited to the measured boundary, contract and test cohort.

stimulus: Battery, generator and flexible load availability windows
Power/energy/thermal limits, SOC reserve and recovery obligation
tests.positive_control: Available flexible resources dispatched within qualified limits.
tests.negative_control: Inject resource unavailability, stale SoC or derated capability; controller must not rely on unavailable flexibility.
tests.recovery_control: Resource returns; controller requalifies capability and restores reserve.
tests.claim_ceiling: Resource flexibility is conditional on qualified device/model/evidence boundaries.

stimulus: Lockout/interlock active while a conflicting operation request is issued
Authority or state mismatch and alarm reset sequence
required_observables: Interlock state and independent contact/protection state
Alarm timestamp, acknowledgement and reset actor
tests.positive_control: Permitted operation while interlocks are clear.
tests.negative_control: Conflicting or forbidden command is blocked; independent protection state does not depend on EMS/Symthaea response.
tests.recovery_control: Authorized reset follows required checks and event remains in audit history.
tests.claim_ceiling: Functional interlock evidence only; protection hardware performance requires corresponding physical tests.

stimulus: Stable isolated microgrid operating points and declared load steps
Grid-forming/following resource mix and bounded disturbance
required_observables: THD and waveform evidence where physically measured
tests.positive_control: Stable operation inside product/site-specific declared acceptance bands.
tests.negative_control: Apply source loss or load step that challenges qualified limits; instability, constraint breach or protection operation must be retained.
tests.recovery_control: Restore source/load and verify stable recovery and reserve constraints.
tests.claim_ceiling: Controller HIL cannot prove physical voltage waveform quality where the converter/network are simulated.

stimulus: Open/close and transfer sequences with feedback delay
Failed, stuck, contradictory or reordered device feedback
required_observables: Command, acknowledgement and observed state timestamps
Electrical/protection waveform and isolation status where physical
Sequence timing and failed attempt IDs
tests.positive_control: Valid device sequence completes with matching physical/status feedback.
tests.negative_control: Reject unsafe ordering, stale state, failed permissive or contradictory feedback.
tests.recovery_control: Reconcile actual state before any further switching attempt.
tests.claim_ceiling: Command logic can be HIL; actual switching/isolation requires the applicable physical device and tests.

stimulus: Grid-connected to islanded transition, resynchronization and reconnection
Communication loss, grid disturbance and delayed source availability
required_observables: Critical load interruption and unserved service
tests.positive_control: Planned transition completes within declared service and electrical limits.
tests.negative_control: Unexpected grid loss, stale sync state or incompatible phase/voltage must not permit unsafe close.
tests.recovery_control: Grid conditions become valid; controller restores mode through explicit synchronization checks.
tests.claim_ceiling: System behavior is limited to the tested model/physical topology and exact protection implementation.

stimulus: P/Q setpoint changes and ramp constraints
Voltage/frequency disturbance and converter current limit
required_observables: P/Q tracking error and response time
Current, voltage, frequency and power-factor traces
tests.positive_control: Setpoint tracked inside declared tolerance without exceeding component envelope.
tests.negative_control: Conflicting P/Q target, current saturation or weak-grid condition triggers bounded limit/fallback.
tests.recovery_control: Disturbance clears and P/Q returns smoothly to a valid setpoint.
tests.claim_ceiling: GFM converter transient and current-limiting claims require appropriately validated EMT and physical evidence.

stimulus: Intentional and unintentional islanding patterns
Ambiguous grid disturbance and communications loss
required_observables: PCC trip/reclose commands and observed breaker state
tests.positive_control: Intentional islanding follows the declared planned transition.
tests.negative_control: Unintentional islanding or non-permissive grid state is detected/handled per applicable requirements; no false state.
tests.recovery_control: Grid returns; reconnection requires fresh synchronized conditions.
tests.claim_ceiling: Detection and protection requirements depend on product class, grid code and local protection scheme.

stimulus: Dead-bus initial conditions and declared start sequence
Sequential DER start and staged critical-load pickup
required_observables: Critical load served and terminal reserve
tests.positive_control: Declared grid-forming resource establishes the island and picks up permitted load sequence.
tests.negative_control: Failed start, inadequate reserve or inrush challenge does not cause unsafe or false black-start pass.
tests.recovery_control: Retry or alternate start path follows bounded safe procedure; final reserve is checked.
tests.claim_ceiling: Physical black-start claims require actual relevant power equipment and appropriately contained testing.

stimulus: End-to-end operation across controller, DER interfaces, protection, communications and operator HMI
Concurrent disturbances and time-stamped state changes
tests.positive_control: All declared interfaces and positive scenarios complete with independently observed postconditions.
tests.negative_control: Inject message loss/reorder, stale status, protection lockout and conflicting state; unknown remains unresolved and cannot become green.
tests.recovery_control: Restore communications/device state and reconcile before permitted new actions.
tests.claim_ceiling: Precommissioning test only; commissioning and periodic site evidence remain separate.
